decisions.reason: The glazed industrial sectional door fits the firm's core industrial door range and was still shown in 2019, so results appear to meet aspirations, and a large firm has the slack to carry it while it consolidates its garage-door experiments.

The insulated glazed industrial door matches the demand for thermal efficiency and the firm's stated focus on thermal solutions, so there is no shortfall that would prompt problemistic search, and the product is kept.
Having its own dedicated page in both 2018 and 2019 signals that management sees the product as performing at or above aspiration within the established industrial segment, so the firm keeps it.
